subject: Lionel Messi
title: Messi offered an Argentina staff job

lines.vo: Argentina have offered Lionel Messi a staff job. Presumably with a clipboard.
lines.footage: Scaloni press conference clip; Messi mention (check for burned-in Spanish subtitles)

lines.vo: He retired from Argentina in August, aged thirty-nine. Retired from playing, not from being asked.
lines.footage: Messi Argentina farewell, 3-0 over Benin, highlights

lines.vo: Scaloni says Messi is welcome, now that Walter Samuel is leaving. Subtle timing.
lines.footage: Scaloni press conference, close-up of the coach speaking

lines.vo: Messi has not replied. Scaloni says he already said no. So, a very quiet interview.
lines.footage: Messi thoughtful close-up, Inter Miami training b-roll

lines.vo: Meanwhile, he scored twenty-six league goals and made seventeen assists. A quiet year, then.
lines.footage: Messi 2026 MLS goals highlights, Nu Stadium

lines.vo: That earned a second straight Golden Boot, a first for MLS. The staff job can wait.

facts_used: Messi retired from Argentina, announced 31 Aug 2026 at 39 (https://abc13.com/story/lionel-messi-says-hes-retiring-playing-argentina/19769980/)

Scaloni: if Messi wants to come, no problem; 'now that Walter is no longer here, let him come'; Scaloni says Messi already said no (Scaloni's account only) (https://www.soccernews.com/scaloni-opens-door-for-messi-to-join-argentina-staff-after-retirement/408295/)

26 goals and 17 assists in 31 MLS games; first player to win the Golden Boot in consecutive seasons; 43 goal contributions, league-best (https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/inter-miami-cf-forward-lionel-messi-wins-2026-mls-golden-boot-presented-by-audi)
notes: Scaloni's 'already said no' is his own account only, so it is attributed on air. The 17 assists figure is derived from 43 goal contributions minus 26 goals, as the source says. No family, health or penalty material used. Non-comic, so no inserts. Punch-up pass: jokes are on the clipboard, the timing and the quiet-year callback only. 'Subtle timing' is a light tease of Scaloni's own quote, with no claim about any dispute.
